question: **Direction: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
Here, the correct answer is **"****Acceptible."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ 

__
 
• The incorrectly spelt word is **"Acceptible."**
 
• The spelling is **"Acceptable."**
 
• **"Acceptable" **means that can be allowed. (जिसे माना जा सके; स्‍वीकार्य)
 
 
• **Example**: *One or two mistakes are **acceptable**__, but no more than that.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__

 
• **Dearth: **a lack of something; not enough of something. (किसी वस्‍तु की कमी; अपर्याप्त)
 
• **Corrupt: **doing or involving illegal or dishonest things in exchange for money, etc. (धन के बदले ग़ैर-कानूनी काम करना अथवा संलिप्त होना; भ्रष्‍ट)
 
• **Barely: **(used especially after ‘can’ and ‘could’ to emphasize that something is difficult to do) only just; almost not. ((विशेषतः ‘can’ और ‘could’ के बाद प्रयुक्त-इस बात पर बल देने के लिए कि अमुक काम कठिन है) मुश्किल से, कठिनाई से)
